topics.topic: Default semantics for omitted project display-name and alias inputs in mapping mode
questions: When a picked project has no replacement display name in the mapping request, does this operation use its v1 name or report a missing required value?
In mapping mode, what do omitted display-name and alias inputs mean, especially on the first request that must reveal the source values?

When the owner picks a project without supplying a name or alias override, does this operation derive the v1 name and absent alias, require `operations` to supply those effective values, or report them as missing?

judgement.why: This is the same omitted project-name and alias question on unchanged text already answered by P1.

precedent.topic: Behavior when an imported project name or alias is omitted
quotes: the display name and alias each will arrive under — its v1 name and no alias unless the owner gives others (R0-85), a name being required (A02).
precedent.why: An omitted replacement uses the v1 display name and no alias; the display name is missing only if neither a replacement nor a usable v1 name supplies the required name.

topics.topic: Duplicate-preserving representation and cardinality of Customer-value mapping inputs
questions: Can the operation receive multiple Customer-value entries for one v1 value, and if so what input representation preserves them for duplicate detection?
Can the operation receive duplicate entries for one v1 customer value, and if so, what input structure preserves them for validation?
Must the operation receive a duplicate-preserving sequence of Customer-value entries so it can detect repeated v1 values, or a keyed collection in which duplicates cannot exist?

judgement.why: This is the same duplicate-preserving Customer mapping-input representation question on unchanged text already assigned to State 6 by P7.

precedent.topic: How duplicate Customer mapping entries are preserved and detected
quotes: The read transaction; the mode, `upload` or `mapping`; the file's bytes; for `mapping`, the picks as the owner gave them, a list that keeps a project given twice so it can be refused — possibly empty — each with the display name and alias it arrives under, and for each Customer the import will make its name, its kind and whether the v1 value is its tax id, keyed by that v1 value: at most one entry for each v1 value the picks bring in — one not yet given is no refusal, the mapping shows it missing; one for a v1 value no pick brings is refused (`outside_closed_list`), one given twice too (`duplicate_pick`).
Inputs and outputs name State 1 models and projections; field types and Python signatures are State 6's.
precedent.why: Whether duplicate keyed submissions are preserved, rejected or collapsed is an input-schema, field-type and transport-decoding question owned by State 6.

topics.topic: Ordering of projects in upload-mode output
questions: In what order does upload mode return the projects: file order or `project_id` order?
In what order are projects returned in `upload` mode?
In what order must upload mode return the projects: by `project_id`, in file order, or another declared order?

judgement.why: This is the same upload-mode project-ordering question on unchanged text already assigned to State 6 by P3.

precedent.topic: Ordering of projects returned in upload mode
quotes: At `upload`, each project the file holds with its id and status.
precedent.why: The ordering of items within the upload answer is a response-schema and encoding detail owned by State 6.

topics.topic: Customer details included in mapping output
questions: Does each Customer in the mapping output also carry the owner-supplied name, kind and tax-id decision, which A16 says the mapping showed, or only its v1 value and linked projects?
Does each Customer in the mapping output include the exact name, kind and tax-id choice that will be bound to confirmation, or only its v1 value and linked projects?

quotes: Customers it will make by their v1 value with the projects each links

The projections an
operation's Outputs name are complete: a fact not listed there is not in
the answer.
judgement.why: The complete output listing includes each prospective Customer's v1 value and linked projects, but not the supplied name, kind or tax-id choice.

topics.topic: Indexing and source basis of record positions in mapping diagnostics
questions: Are record positions zero-based, one-based, or otherwise defined?
Is the reported position zero-based or one-based, and is it the position in the original file rather than in a filtered collection of picked records?

quotes: its position among the file's records of that kind
judgement.why: The text fixes the source collection as the file's records of that kind, while the numeric indexing convention is an output-schema and encoding detail owned by State 6.

topics.topic: Error behavior for absent or blank required mapping values
questions: When a required imported display name, Customer name, or Customer kind is absent or blank in mapping mode, does this operation return a non-clean mapping or refuse the call with `invalid_request` / `missing_value`?

witness.initial: An accepted uploaded file contains a project that names v1 customer value `X`, and the owner has not yet supplied the required Customer name or kind for `X`.
events: The owner picks that project and requests its import mapping.
`operations` calls `migration_import.read_import_mapping` in mapping mode, which reads the required Customer values through the public given-value rules.
outcomes: The operation returns a mapping that shows the Customer value as missing and marks the mapping not clean.
The operation refuses with `invalid_request` and kind `missing_value`, returning no mapping.
witness.observer: The owner sees either the incomplete mapping or a refusal.

file (R0-79), confirming the mapping Registry shows (A16).
